action.text: Task: Fix MultilineContinuationError doc entry. Issues: (1) parenthetical equates continuation with any line beginning with whitespace — need to specify it's about first non-whitespace character being indented further than the option header's; (2) allow_no_value should be clearly a constructor parameter, not an attribute. Current candidate 7fc13aa1. Public check already passes. Need to patch Doc/library/configparser.rst, re-run check, submit.

action.new:
.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   Exception raised when a continuation line follows an option that has
   no value.  A continuation line, as determined by the parser, is a
   non-blank, non-comment line whose first non-whitespace character is
   indented further than the first non-whitespace character of the line
   introducing the option.  This condition can only arise when the
   parser was created with the ``allow_no_value`` parameter set to
   ``True``.  Subclass of :exc:`ParsingError`.
action.old:
.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   Exception raised when a continuation line (a non-blank, non-comment
   line whose indentation is greater than that of the preceding option)
   follows an option that has no value.  This condition is only possible
   when the ``allow_no_value`` constructor option is ``True``.  Subclass
   of :exc:`ParsingError`.
